title: Ordering, Artin--Tits group, Garside structure
summary: A Dehornoy structure is a tool used to obtain a left order in the Garside group~$G$. Arcis and Paris introduced two conditions, known as Condition~$A$ and Condition~$B$. When they are both satisfied, they ensure that~$G$ possesses a Dehornoy structure. These two conditions describes how the product in the corresponding monoid behaves with an alternating decomposition. Here, we consider the case of a spherical type Artin group~$G$. We prove that Condition A almost always holds, but Condition~$B$ is rarely satisfied.
